run.change_description:
Update conn state to prevent concurrent connection attempts

Make callers of resetBackoff() lock the mutex

Add doc comment for resetTransportAndUnlock

Merge remote-tracking branch 'source/master' into fix_conn_connect_race

summary.intent: Hold `ac.mu` continuously across the Idle-state check and the call into `resetTransport` so a second, concurrent `connect()`/`updateAddrs()` cannot also observe `Idle` and start a parallel connection attempt, fixing the flaky `Test/AuthorityRevive` and the orphaned-transport race analyzed in grpc/grpc-go#7365.
summary.issue_fit: Met — the fix matches the root cause the issue's investigation established (a released-then-reacquired lock let two callers both observe `Idle` and both call `resetTransport`) and the remedy the reviewers agreed on (transition to `Connecting` before releasing `ac.mu`, via a renamed `resetTransportAndUnlock` that assumes the lock and unconditionally releases it).
summary.coverage: Complete merge-base diff reviewed (clientconn.go, 1/1 diff chunk); balancer_wrapper.go read for the sole external callers of `connect()`/`updateAddrs()`; two concurrency safety premises (continuous lock-holding across the Idle check, and guaranteed unlock on every `resetTransportAndUnlock` exit path) verified by a fresh-context worker — both `holds`; `Test/AuthorityRevive` run 20x with `-race` at the reviewed head: all passed.

requirements.evidence: clientconn.go:1261-1262 sets Connecting before unlocking, closing the window the issue's root-cause comment identified; verifier premise-1 and premise-2 both ruled holds (see record.verification.tasks).

The double resetTransport invocation the issue traced to a released-then-reacquired lock is eliminated by the single critical section in connect()/updateAddrs(); Test/AuthorityRevive passed 20/20 with -race at head 76ef33f44a600c3ed1a385979fd1dfbcade3fbb6.

requirements.evidence: arjan-bal's issue comment traces the orphaned-transport symptom to the same double-connect race (only one of two parallel transports gets recorded in ac.transport); the fix removes that race's only trigger.

tasks.premise: ac.mu stays continuously locked from the Idle/non-terminal-state check in connect()/updateAddrs() until resetTransportAndUnlock transitions ac.state to Connecting and unlocks, so no concurrent caller can observe Idle in that window.

resetTransportAndUnlock unlocks ac.mu on every reachable exit path, whether run synchronously in connect()'s goroutine or in the goroutine updateAddrs() spawns, so the lock is never left permanently held.
